purpose: The production corrections of this round touch the bus, the job service, the retry loop and the RabbitMQ test harness. Every category that consumes them has to be shown green again before any freeze, whichever option the lead chooses.

pack.note: Package hashes moved against the freeze because the assemblies carry the corrections; the set of 33 packages is unchanged.

togetherWithRecord0033: With policy, build, analyzer, core, rabbitmq and the public API comparison bound in record 0033, every required category of this order has now been executed against the corrected tree. What is missing for a freeze is not a run; it is the disposition of F-1 to F-3.
